race.comment: ALL ADORE (6) was only beaten just over two lengths in the Listed Denise's Joy Stakes two runs back, then ended the campaign with a tenth in a Quality at Sunshine Coast where the margin was still under four lengths. This looks a strong kickoff point for her and a forward showing is on the cards. MASSIRA (5) also resumes and his recent form before the break was plain, but he was contesting BM72 and BM78 races in town and remains well suited around 1000m. Can run a strong race on resumption. ACTION KING (1) has the strongest current form line, coming off a Canterbury BM78 fifth with excuses after winning at Canberra, and the easier meeting helps him. STARLIGHT GIRL (7) brings winning form from Sapphire Coast and a recent second to ACTION KING, so she is a genuine place hope with a winning hope if she can turn that matchup around.
